data.one_liner: A simple dependency injection and service locator implementation that avoids mirrors.
data.what_it_does: Allows registering types, singletons, and simple values using factory functions. It supports multiple isolated injectors, named types, and passing parameters during instance retrieval without relying on code generation or dart:mirrors.
use_when: You want a straightforward dependency injection container without code generation overhead.
You need support for multiple isolated injector instances for testing or isolates.
avoid_when: You prefer compile-time safe dependency injection via code generation like injectable.
You want a fully-featured reactive scope manager.
strengths: No code generation or mirrors required, leading to high performance.
Supports multiple named injectors and isolated containers.
Allows passing additional parameters when retrieving instances.
weaknesses: Manual mapping of every type and dependency is required.
No compile-time safety or verification of dependencies.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the injector.

alternatives.name: get_it
alternatives.why_pick_it: It is widely used, highly mature, and provides a similar lightweight service locator approach.

alternatives.name: injectable
alternatives.why_pick_it: It uses code generation to automatically wire up dependencies, saving manual mapping effort.
